gloss: to be popular; to be attractive

definitions.gloss: to be popular (romantically); to be attractive
definitions.explanation: To be well-liked or sought after, especially in a romantic or dating context.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{女性|じょせい}にモテる。
{学生|がくせい}{時代|じだい}は{全然|ぜんぜん}モテなかった。
examples.english: I wasn't popular at all during my school days.

notes:
モテる comes from {持|も}てる (to be able to hold/have), meaning "to be held in regard" or "to be in demand." Usually written in katakana to emphasize its slang nature.

REGISTER:
This is casual/colloquial language commonly used when discussing dating and popularity.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～にモテる: to be popular with (a group)
- モテ{男|おとこ}/モテ{女|おんな}: a popular guy/girl
- モテ{期|き}: a period when one is popular
- モテたい: to want to be popular
- 非モテ: someone who isn't popular (slang)
